prompt: Launch page for Tidyup, a mobile app that helps families plan chores and shared shopping lists, with features, key numbers and a call to download

data.title: The family to-do list that actually gets done
data.subtitle: Tidyup lets everyone at home see who is doing what: chores, shared shopping lists and reminders, all in one calm app for iPhone and Android.

features.title: Chores with a rotation
features.description: Set up weekly chores once and Tidyup rotates them fairly. Kids earn stars, adults get a break from reminding.

features.title: One shopping list for everyone
features.description: Add an item from the sofa and it shows up for whoever is at the store. Items are grouped by aisle.

features.title: Gentle reminders
features.description: Nudges arrive at the right time, not all at once. Quiet hours keep evenings peaceful.

features.title: Works offline
features.description: No signal in the basement supermarket? Your lists stay available and sync when you are back online.

data.title: Families are using it every day
data.subtitle: Numbers from the first six months.

testimonials.quote: We stopped arguing about the dishes in the first week. The rotation just takes the drama out of it.

testimonials.quote: My kids actually ask to do their chores now because of the stars. I did not see that coming.

testimonials.quote: The shared shopping list alone is worth it. No more duplicate milk.

questions.question: Is Tidyup free?
questions.answer: The app is free for one household with up to six members. Tidyup Plus adds extra lists, history and custom reward charts for a small yearly fee.

questions.question: Can kids use it without an account?
questions.answer: Yes. Children join with a code from a parent, with no email needed, and parents control what they can see and edit.

questions.question: Which devices are supported?
questions.answer: Tidyup works on iPhone with iOS 16 or later and on Android phones with version 10 or later. A web view is on the roadmap.

questions.question: Where is my data stored?
questions.answer: Your household data is stored in the EU and is never sold or used for advertising. You can export or delete it at any time from the settings.

data.title: Give your house a calmer routine
data.subtitle: Download Tidyup for free and set up your first chore in under two minutes.

data.description: A friendly app for families who share a home, a list and a lot of laundry.
